decks.title: First guest · Knights
decks.subtitle: Archers and Squires fill lanes while Heralds look for reinforcements.

decks.title: First guest · Beasts
decks.subtitle: Rabbits make room for Wolves. Foragers draw free Beasts while Hedgehogs hold a lane.

decks.title: First guest · Robots
decks.subtitle: Five Tinbots and five Coglets fill the lanes.

decks.title: First guest · Fairies
decks.subtitle: Pucks hold the front while Spellkeepers find Stardust and healing.

decks.title: Cogsworth
decks.subtitle: Shield Projectors protect nearby Robots. Gear Oracles can draw Treads.

decks.title: Oren
decks.subtitle: Four Archers, four Heralds and three Squires support two Commanders. Break Enchantment answers a buffed unit.

decks.title: Fenwick
decks.subtitle: Turning Current shifts the lanes. Watch for Lantern Angler drawing another Fish behind the small swimmers.

decks.title: First travelling guest · Knights
decks.subtitle: Pages threaten promotion and a Standard Bearer reinforces the familiar Knight line.

decks.title: First travelling guest · Beasts
decks.subtitle: Foxes join the Rabbits, while Foragers and a Burrow Warden draw free Beasts.

decks.title: First travelling guest · Robots
decks.subtitle: Sparkers add immediate attack. Repair Kit helps the larger machines stay in play.

decks.title: First travelling guest · Fairies
decks.subtitle: Mirror Sprites and Pixie Tricksters disrupt lanes while Spellkeepers keep spells in hand.

decks.title: Second travelling guest · Knights
decks.subtitle: A Knight joins the Pages. War Drum and Standard Bearer reward building a board.

decks.title: Second travelling guest · Beasts
decks.subtitle: An Eagle threatens direct damage while Foragers and Burrow Warden replenish the hand.

decks.title: Second travelling guest · Robots
decks.subtitle: Repair Bots and Repair Kit support the shift from small machines to Rivet.

decks.title: Second travelling guest · Fairies
decks.subtitle: Pixie Tricksters swap opposing units. Sprite can hit a second enemy beside its target.

decks.title: Aster
decks.subtitle: Prism Reader and Moon Archivist fetch spells. Look for Sprite before deciding which lane to defend.

decks.title: Sir Rowan
decks.subtitle: Oren’s Heralds return alongside Pages. Oath Marshal and Oath Avenger give the Knight line two heavier threats.

decks.title: Vesper
decks.subtitle: Loosebone Scouts leave Bones to spend. Ossuary and Banshee support the second wave.

decks.title: Alder
decks.subtitle: Berry Bush and Orchard Keeper supply Sunfruit, while quills make some lanes expensive to attack.

decks.title: Bramble
decks.subtitle: Den Matron draws free Beasts. Elder of the Grove heals the pack. Wild Grove rewards leaving several Beasts standing.

decks.title: Bram
decks.subtitle: All eight families meet at the final table. Dawn Squire can promote while Sprite and Linked Reactor bring back threats from earlier duels.
